reuse.why: Writes its own copy of the field-clearing that unlinkAccount does and its own copy of the holder lookup from assertBankAccountNotLinked, instead of pulling the local-only unlink step out of unlinkAccount and sharing the lookup.

duplication.why: Two verbatim copies: the 'SELECT id FROM accounts WHERE tombstone = 0 AND account_sync_source = ? AND account_id = ? AND id IS NOT ?' query (already in assertBankAccountNotLinked) and the db.updateAccount block that nulls account_id/bank/balances/sync source/status (already in unlinkAccount).

placement.why: The takeover happens in linkBankSyncAccount and the check is relaxed in assertBankAccountNotLinked, the shared link path all providers go through, which is the right layer.

scope.why: Only the link path and its parameter plumbing in accounts/app.ts change.

maintainability.why: The shared link helpers are used, but the flag has to be threaded by hand through all six provider functions and the copied 'unlinked state' definition can drift from unlinkAccount's; no tests were added.

bypasses_abstraction.where: accounts/app.ts linkBankSyncAccount clears the holder account's link fields itself instead of going through the local-state part of unlinkAccount
